 Bayern Munich 0-1 Arsenal 
 Arsenal have the lead and are looking pretty comfortable at the moment. Bayern have had a couple of moments but otherwise done very little. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 278 69 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:30 BST 20:30 BST 
 Real Madrid 0-0 RB Leipzig 
 Elizabeth Conway 
BBC Sport Spanish football reporter at the Bernabeu 
 That was the biggest chance of the night so far and it came for Leipzig. 
 Romulo with a cracking left-footed volley has forced Courtois to make a brilliant save. 
 65 16 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Take a moment to praise Martin Odegaard's pass' published at 20:30 BST 20:30 BST 
 Bayern Munich 0-1 Arsenal 
 Matt Upson 
Former Arsenal defender on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Take a moment to praise Martin Odegaard's pass. It's a brilliant left footed ball, it really is. He sees the space, and whips it from centre field. Eze's onto it, and it's a quality finish from his left foot.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 447 99 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:28 BST 20:28 BST 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Viking 
 Ross Barkley has been directly involved in six goals in his last three starts across all competitions (four goals, two assists).
 He has scored in three consecutive starts for the first time since October 2020 (one for Chelsea, two for Aston Villa).
 336 25 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:27 BST 20:27 BST 
 Real Betis 0-0 Feyenoord 
 Republic of Ireland international Troy Parrott is in action for Real Betis against Feyenoord tonight.
 The former Tottenham and AZ Alkmaar man has helped the La Liga side record back-to-back wins in the Champions League this season. 
 98 11 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:27 BST 20:27 BST 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Viking 
 It should be 2-0! 
 Alysson's ball is palmed by Arild Ostbo and lands to Emiliano Buendia, completely unmarked, six yards out, with half the goal to aim for - but he nods it wide somehow.
 Sitter.
 175 114 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Video Assistant Referee - goal stands published at 20:26 BST 20:26 BST 
 Bayern Munich 0-1 Arsenal 
 The goal stands! 
 Eberechi Eze was played onside by Josip Stanisic on the other side of the pitch and Arsenal fans can celebrate!
 1437 411 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'He's just a safe pair of hands for any club' published at 20:26 BST 20:26 BST 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Viking 
 Matt Upson 
Former Arsenal defender on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Unai Emery just manages to have the touch doesn't he in European competitions. He's just a safe pair of hands for any club you feel. He understands the demands of the cup very well.
 321 40 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:26 BST 20:26 BST 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Viking 
 Another chance for Villa straight after the goal but Ibrahim Mbaye's effort - after cutting in from the wing - is saved.

 Eberechi Eze charges into the box from the left after being sent away by Martin Odegaard and sends a fine strike into the bottom corner, but was he offside? It was close.
